```{r setup}
library(hlebuhanec.0325)
library(GimmeMyStats)
library(GimmeMyPlot)
library(rlist)
```

```{r}
disease <- "da"
data("microbiome_processed")
data("metadata_microbiome")

metadata_microbiome$sexe <- as.factor(metadata_microbiome$sexe)
microbiome_processed <- microbiome_processed %>%
  column_to_rownames("species")
l_micro <- list(metadata = pull(metadata_microbiome, "patient"), counts = colnames(microbiome_processed))
plot_venn(l_micro)

common_ids <- intersect(l_micro[[1]], l_micro[[2]])
```

```{r}
idx <- filter(metadata_microbiome, patient %in% common_ids & group == str_to_upper(disease)) %>% pull("patient")
microbiome_processed2 <- microbiome_processed[, idx]
metadata_microbiome2 <- filter(metadata_microbiome, patient %in% idx,) %>%
  rename(Patient = "patient")
c("sexe", "age", "lectures_bacteriennes") %>%
  list.map(~plot_pca2(microbiome_processed2, metadata_microbiome2, .))

microbiome_adj_pn <- microbiome_processed2
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
usethis::use_data(microbiome_adj_da, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
plot_bar_2cat(
    select(metadata_microbiome, "sexe", "group"),
    sort = c("HD", "DA", "PN")
)
library("ggrepel")
vars <- c("age", "lectures_bacteriennes", "part_scenarioA_%")
metadata_microbiome0 <- rename(metadata_microbiome, groupe = "group")

plot_violin_group(
  metadata_microbiome0,
  vars,
  identity,
  method = "wilcox",
  display_log = TRUE
)
print_group_numeric(metadata_microbiome0, vars, identity)
```
